def dt_format_to_regex(fmt):
    # escape regex special chars except %.
    # iterate through fmt, building regex.
    result = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(fmt):
        c = fmt[i]
        if c == '%':
            i += 1
            if i >= len(fmt):
                raise ValueError('Incomplete format code at end')
            code = fmt[i]
            if code == '%':
                result.append('%')
            else:
                pattern = _DT_FORMAT_MAP.get(code)
